_note: v2.3 L5, the destination V15 never covered: leaving a group chat that plays a story for a SOLO character chat. The story's host effects must be put back on the group the ledger recorded (Luke re-enabled), the solo chat must read no story, and returning to the group chat must re-apply the checkpoint (Luke disabled again). Restart then clears it for good and the group is left as it was found. Run with --sandbox --group 1759606632088; the solo destination is the install's 'Assistant' character, whose own chat is only opened, never written. The excursion to the solo chat and the return are ONE step: the sandbox guard checks the page before every step, so a step that ends outside the sandbox aborts the next one by design (first two runs, 2026-09-24).
